scope: P01 onward, including future added pages
purpose: Keep ornament production rooted in Rurubu-style editorial design, coherent as Rurubu WEDDING V30, adaptable by page role, and scalable when pages are added without forcing every ornament into one identical illustration style.

authorityModel.principle: P01 is a successful calibration reference, not the root authority. The root is the Rurubu-inspired editorial language; P01-P08 Visual Masters collectively calibrate how V30 translates that language.
authorityModel.hardReject: Do not make all later pages imitate P01 cover density, composition or ornament count merely for consistency.

principles: EDITORIAL_FIRST: decoration exists to help photos, headings, information blocks and reading flow; a beautiful standalone illustration is not automatically a good magazine ornament.
DENSE_BUT_READABLE: lively information density with strong size contrast, calm zones and clear hierarchy instead of uniform decorative noise.
PHOTO_AND_INFORMATION_LED: ornaments support the editorial content and do not become the main subject unless the page Visual Master explicitly gives them that role.

MIXED_MEDIA_UNDER_ONE_ART_DIRECTION: photos, cutouts, doodles, icons, stamps, routes, paper objects and illustrations may mix; they need not share one literal drawing style, but they must feel selected and art-directed by the same publication team.

PLAYFUL_EDITORIAL_UTILITY: arrows, routes, stickers, cutouts, badges and small motifs should guide attention, connect modules, activate edges or add narrative meaning rather than simply fill empty space.
TACTILE_PRINT_CHARACTER: use controlled hand-drawn/printed/paper character where useful, without turning the page into fine-art watercolor, vintage poster art or generic digital sticker packs.
LOCAL_VARIATION_WITH_GLOBAL_COHERENCE: page roles may change density and motif mix while remaining recognizably part of the same magazine.
hardRejects: standalone artwork whose beauty dominates its editorial usefulness
high-detail botanical art used as a corner ornament when it reads like an independent illustration plate
retro poster illustration inserted into a lighter editorial page without a deliberate page-role reason
forcing every ornament into an identical drawing style and losing Rurubu-like mixed-media energy
mixing unrelated illustration genres with no shared editorial treatment

v30ArtDirection.principle: Translate the Rurubu editorial DNA into a joyful travel-wedding publication: bright, warm, tactile, photo-led, playful and print-oriented, but not childish, stock-like or over-illustrated.

calibrationSources.primary: current P01-P08 Visual Masters as a set
calibrationSources.p01Role: GLOBAL_STYLE_CALIBRATION_REFERENCE, especially for print tactility, cutout/sticker energy, edge activation and travel-magazine playfulness; not a page-template to clone
calibrationSources.pageSpecific: the target page Visual Master controls local density, motif choice, scale and calm-vs-busy balance

coherenceDimensions: relationship to photography and native text
v30ArtDirection.controlledVariation: Different ornament families may use different drawing methods. Consistency means compatible editorial treatment and visual weight, not identical brushwork.

ornamentFamilyRegistry.principle: Families are reusable visual vocabularies, not libraries of identical repeated assets. A page selects or extends a family, then creates locally appropriate variants.

families.role: connect modules, imply movement, activate empty space
families.reuseMode: grammar shared; exact path/shape normally page-specific

examples: car where page role supports it
families.reuseMode: family character shared; vehicle and pose generated for local page role
botanical vocabulary may recur, but major clusters must be independently composed
shared material/print treatment; object chosen for page meaning
intentional recurring motif family; exact placement/combination varies

ornamentFamilyRegistry.extensionRule: A future page may introduce a new ornament family only when its page role cannot be served well by an existing family. The new family must first pass RURUBU_EDITORIAL_DNA_PASS and V30_ART_DIRECTION_PASS before page assets are produced.

whyNotGenerateEverythingUpfront: final scale, crop, negative space and overlap depend on the actual page composition
unused pre-generated assets create sunk-work pressure and encourage inappropriate carry-over
page Visual Masters or copy/photo changes can make early final assets obsolete
large one-shot batches tend to drift into multiple illustration genres or a generic asset-pack look
whyNotPurePageByPage: without an upfront family system, each page can invent a new style
shared publication furniture and recurring motif grammar drift
future pages cannot reliably reuse the visual language

phases.when: before scaling production across many pages
phases.action: Inventory visible/likely ornament slots across all currently reviewed page Visual Masters. Record role, family candidate, shared-vs-page-specific nature, saliency and whether it is actually needed. Do not generate final art here.
phases.futurePageRule: When P09+ is added, append that page's ornament-slot inventory instead of redesigning the whole system.

phases.action: For each materially used family, establish only 1-2 representative calibration anchors or reference treatments. Judge them against Rurubu editorial DNA and V30 art direction before producing many variants.
phases.hardRule: Calibration anchors are style references, not assets that must be copied into every page.

phases.action: Create true cross-page common components once as a coherent system. PAGE badge and other explicitly shared publication furniture belong here, not in page ornament generation.

Produce final page-specific ornament variants only after the target page hierarchy, photos, native text and negative-space needs are known. Prefer small batches by family within the page or spread so related variants can be compared together.
Accepted assets write back family id, page role, local job, reuse intent, art-direction notes and alpha status. Rejected assets do not become future references merely because they exist.

productionArchitecture.batchingRule: Batch the DESIGN SYSTEM early; do not batch all FINAL ICONS early. For final assets, batch related variants together only when shared context makes comparison useful.

pageAdditionWorkflow: inventory ornament slots and editorial jobs
map each need to an existing family when appropriate
if no existing family fits, request a family extension instead of inventing an untracked style
write accepted family/asset decisions back to registry
futurePageScalability.hardRule: Adding a page must not require recreating all prior ornament assets or copying a previous page's ornament set.

evaluationGates.RURUBU_EDITORIAL_DNA_PASS: Does the ornament function as Rurubu-style editorial material rather than merely good standalone art?
evaluationGates.V30_ART_DIRECTION_PASS: Does it feel compatible with the Rurubu WEDDING V30 publication as a whole?
evaluationGates.PAGE_ROLE_FIT_PASS: Is its visual weight, motif and density appropriate for this specific page role and local position?
evaluationGates.ORNAMENT_FAMILY_COHERENCE_PASS: Does it belong to its declared family while remaining a locally distinct variant?
evaluationGates.ORNAMENT_OBJECT_QUALITY_PASS: Is the individual asset itself well drawn/designed at the required A5 use size?
evaluationGates.REUSE_INTENT_PASS: If a motif repeats, is the repetition intentional publication language rather than convenience/carry-over?
evaluationGates.TRUE_ALPHA_PREFLIGHT_PASS: If floating transparency is required, does the production asset satisfy the current true-alpha generation policy before Figma placement?

antiPattern: Do not approve a beautiful asset at ORNAMENT_OBJECT_QUALITY_PASS if it already failed a higher-level editorial/art-direction gate.
